answer: Identity bonds that decay stop a gale of fake accounts. Each agent posts a 1,000 POA bond and earns an ivory seal. It loses 5% per epoch without attested work; below 500 POA the identity is suspended and its votes discounted, so one lapse sends a ripple through its ballots. Forging 100 identities costs 100,000 POA plus 5,000 POA per epoch, while honest work refills the bond free. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full reward.
